import hashlib,pathlib,json
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/source')
man=json.loads((root/'incoming/manifest.json').read_text())
rep=json.loads((root/'incoming/build-report.json').read_text())
h=json.loads((root/'incoming/handoff-receipt.json').read_text())
print('RECEIPT')
for n,exp in h['files_sha256'].items():
 b=(root/'incoming'/n).read_bytes()
 dig=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
 print(n, dig==exp, len(b), dig)
print('MANIFEST vs SOURCE')
for n,exp in man['files_sha256'].items():
 p=root/n
 if not p.exists():
  print('MISSING', n); continue
 dig=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print(('MATCH' if dig==exp else 'DIFF'), n, p.stat().st_size)
print('source files not in map:')
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file() and 'incoming' not in p.parts:
  rel=str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/')

   print(' ', rel, p.stat().st_size)
